## Remaining bounded metadata corrections

1. **TVN measurements were replaced with another blanket assumption.** Every bar now has `16 bars (1kg / 1040g)`, `70g (1 bar)` and identical `22g protein;7g net carbs;5g fats;stevia sweetened;gluten free`, all claimed visible/high. Caramel source clearly prints 22g/7g/5g, 70gm per bar and 16 bars; the previous 20g/65g reading was wrong. Several older-style flavors also show 1KG plus70gm/bar, an internal packaging inconsistency that must be preserved as a contradiction, not harmonized. The newer-design products have their own nutrition panels; a shared nutrient/70g entry and shared feature badges cannot be accepted without reading each panel. `1040g` is not substantiated by the inspected views. Keep observed count, printed net weight and per-bar weight separate; unknown where unreadable. Stevia is visible on newer-style variants but not substantiated on every older-style pack. These affect metadata, not the confirmed flavor identities or source art.
2. **Serving-size evidence needs exact location.** Tractor Citrulline 130 GM/40 servings and front 3000MG are visible. FIELD_EVIDENCE calls 3.25g a printed front serving-size value, but that front value was not visible in the reviewed original. If a readable facts panel provides it, cite that exact region; otherwise mark unverified rather than treating a division result as printed. Same standard applies to other inferred serving quantities.
3. **85 is a row partition, not independently established unique SKU count.** Improved status partition is 85 VERIFIED_INTAKE rows,7 UNRESOLVED_PACKAGING_CANDIDATE,3 MULTI_ITEM_DISPLAY. Use those terms. Distinct packaging images, sale variants and observed individual shakers are different measures. Preserve all95 images. No need to resolve the seven SP packaging alternatives before visual cleanup.
4. **Reports still misdescribe native output and background provenance.** REVISED_REPORT claims native studio_packshot/retail_shelf/finished_goods and native protein bar/box/gym bag/tablet bottle tags, which are not in the audited supplements profile. Describe actual catalog values; separate human source-background annotations. Its 18white breakdown incorrectly names EN tubs/Farah. Earlier all-sheet review found 13 TVN bars plus TVN Gainer,2 TVN tubs,Cream of Rice,Beef Aminos;77 retail/other. That is screening, not final pixel QA. Correct sheet filenames G001.jpg…G015.jpg and remove residual “95 verified variants” prose.

Goals improved: TVN unsupported muscle-building/recovery goals now read unverified. Product statuses now distinguish packaging candidates and displays. These improvements should be retained; they do not make every field verified.
